name: Sky Slot
summary: A delivery slot picker whose sky, sun, moon and city lights follow the hour you choose
about: A checkout step for choosing when your order arrives. Pick a day from a strip built from the real calendar and a two-hour window; the sky above repaints from morning peach to midday blue, sunset violet and starry night while the sun rides its arc on a spring, windows light up and a delivery rider nips along the road. Fees differ by slot and the PKR total updates; booking sends the rider to your door, drops a pin and swings in a ticket.
how: Choose a day: a dark pill springs across the strip and the time slots flip in one after another
Choose a time: the sky, city and sun or moon move to that hour and the rider rides to a new spot
Past and full slots are shaded and cannot be picked; Saver and Peak slots change the delivery fee
Press Book slot: the rider backs up, rides to the house, a pin drops and a booked ticket swings in
Press Change slot, or pick another time, to cancel the booking and choose again
